title: LADEDA Plotting Handbook
creator: R. D. Williams
publisher: Water and Soil Science Centre, Ministry of Works and Development, Christchurch, for the National Water and Soil Conservation Organisation
publicationDecision: Hold all extracts. No document-specific redistribution licence or authority over the Crown material established.

rightsEvidence.finding: General CC BY 4.0 offer excludes identified third-party content and logos. The scan identifies a Ministry of Works and Development Crown work; no transfer or licensing authority for this item verified.
Permission required for publications purchased or ordered through NIWA. Its application to this freely hosted historical scan is uncertain; not treated as definitive prohibition or permission.
Crown works generally have a 100-year term. Bibliographic access and a download do not establish a republication licence.

inspection.method: Full PDF rendered at 130 dpi; bounded OCR used as a finding aid. Every listed plot page inspected visually against its explanatory text. Faint command listings are not reconstructed from OCR guesses.
limitations: Scanned paper outputs, not original digital plot files or screenshots.
Several faint command listings, binding shadows, bleed-through and adjoining-page fragments. No image clean-up or reconstruction.
Some published plots were reduced. Printed scale labels must not be asserted as physical scale of an online derivative.
Plots visibly use NZ National Yard Grid, not proof of NZ Map Grid in this plotting workflow.
No original digitising workstation photograph or capture session is shown.

workflowEvidence.finding: PLOT writes an intermediate vector-and-character file, followed by TSO PLOT or LDDPLOT for CALCOMP, VERSATEC or TEKTRONIX output.

proseReviewIssues.finding: Preface dates digitisation 1977–1981; accepted institutional chronology says 1977–1980. Preserve both trails for editorial review.

Preface credits van Berkel directing digitisation, A. M. Moffat writing the initial 1980 program, R. Christian converting boundaries in 1981, Williams continuing development. Do not silently rewrite accepted attribution.
Plots label NZ National Yard Grid. This is narrower evidence than a claim about all database storage coordinates.
Accepted note still describes handbook as unavailable. Retrieval and inspection now resolve availability; note preserved under instruction, correction pending separately.

plots.subject: Mosgiel: every map unit
plots.limitations: Unique unit numbers retain all segments; coarse enquiry omits some edge units.

plots.subject: Mosgiel: common segments removed
plots.limitations: Equal adjacent LUC values suppress their common boundary; not a fresh field survey.

plots.subject: Mosgiel: LUC class grouping
plots.limitations: Class-only output removes more segments; some repeated labels survive the algorithm.

plots.subject: Dunedin: smaller-scale LUC plot
plots.limitations: Two adjoining frames; enquiry spans S154, S155, S163 and S164. Labels overlap at small scale.

plots.subject: Dunedin: broad land grouping
plots.limitations: Virtual arable/non-arable field; non-normal units excluded. Larger minimum vectors coarsen lines.

plots.subject: Levin: coarse circular overlay
plots.limitations: Centroid selection includes whole units, not clipped areas. It is not an original worksheet.

plots.subject: Levin: exact circular overlay
plots.limitations: Intersections calculate proportions; crowded edge labels move away from their units. Exact overlay was still developing.

plots.subject: Levin: overlay with margin
plots.limitations: Margin improves edge interpretation; it does not change the source inventory precision.

plots.subject: Paparua: worksheet frames
plots.limitations: Worksheet boundaries and county frame, not a resource-class map. Commands deliberately omitted after reduction.

plots.subject: Paparua: basic frame layout
plots.limitations: Shares a page with Plot 3.3; only frames and county outline. No command listing.

plots.subject: Paparua: blocked frames
plots.limitations: Shares a page with Plot 3.2; full page must remain uncropped. No command listing.

plots.subject: Paparua: aligned frames
plots.limitations: Shares a page with Plot 3.5; frames aligned to worksheet origins. No command listing.

plots.subject: Paparua: aligned and blocked frames
plots.limitations: Shares a page with Plot 3.4; reduced frame diagram, not a full-sized working plot.

plots.subject: North Island: tunnel-gully centroids
plots.limitations: Stars mark unit centres; density is not adjusted for unit area and can mislead.

plots.subject: North Island: tunnel-gully unit boundaries
plots.limitations: Selected inventory-unit boundaries, not surveyed gully outlines; labels suppressed.

plots.subject: North Canterbury: selected LUC units
plots.limitations: Indexed letters identify selected LUC units; crowded letters cannot all be distinguished.

plots.subject: S172: selected wetland vegetation
plots.limitations: Two frames; extracted vegetation, not the original complete S172 worksheet. Labels meet frame edges.
